ex.s: Besides cooking, what other life skills would you like to develop?
ex.t: 除了烹饪，你还想培养哪些其他生活技能？

ex.s: Besides performing and modeling, Hannah travels the world given/giving presentations and talks, getting more people involved/involving in the conservation of ocean life.
ex.t: 除了表演和模特工作，汉娜还在世界各地做演讲和讲座，让更多人参与到海洋生物保护中来。

ex.s: Besides drip irrigation and hydroponics, scientists have made impressive innovations in agricultural machinery.
ex.t: 除了滴灌和水培技术，科学家们还在农业机械方面取得了令人瞩目的创新。

defs.def: in addition; also 此外；以及；也

ex.s: Besides, working in the garden seems to have a calming effect on Jaramillo’s special education students, many of whom have emotional control issues.
ex.t: 此外，在花园里工作似乎对贾拉米略的特殊教育学生产生了平息效应，其中许多学生有情绪控制问题。

ex.s: I don't think it should be… Besides, … Are you serious?!
ex.t: 我觉得不应该是…… 此外，…… 你是认真的吗？！

ex.s: Besides, it would cost a lot of money to send her to a school in another country.
ex.t: 此外，把她送到另一个国家的学校读书要花很多钱。

ex.s: Besides, your parents will also be able to participate in workshops selected just for them to learn about cutting-edge science.
ex.t: 此外，你的父母也能参加专为家长挑选的研讨会，了解前沿科学。

chunks.cn: 而且 它 将 费用
而且 你的 父亲
